description: Client-side JavaScript for retrieving and managing dashboard pages and UI interactions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: retrievePage
methods.description: Initiates delayed retrieval of dashboard page data by page ID.

methods.name: retrieveData
methods.description: Performs AJAX request to fetch dashboard page content and updates the UI.

methods.name: outputPage
methods.description: Outputs the retrieved page content into the designated tab content container.

methods.name: dashletsPageInit
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for dashboard UI components, including modals and delete buttons.
